pr_title: Implement renameTo and createDirectory[AndParents] for RemoteActionFileSystem

issue_context.title: test.xml missing when running flaky test
issue_context.body:
### Description of the bug:


When running a flaky test with the `--flaky_test_attempts=10` and `--remote_download_minimal` flags with remote execution, bazel build execution will stop if the test fails with the following error message: 
ERROR: /data/repos/test_repo/BUILD:9:8: Testing //:python_test failed: unexpected I/O exception: /home/ekattainen/.cache/bazel/_bazel_ekattainen/f465db4dd2df63e33090e2c00fda9ac6/execroot/__main__/bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/testlogs/python_test/test.xml -> /home/ekattainen/.cache/bazel/_bazel_ekattainen/f465db4dd2df63e33090e2c00fda9ac6/execroot/__main__/bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/testlogs/python_test/test_attempts/attempt_1.xml (No such file or directory)

### What's the simplest, easiest way to reproduce this bug? Please provide a minimal example if possible.


Have a workspace with empty WORKSPACE file and BUILD and flaky_test.py files with following contents 
```
$ cat BUILD
py_test(
    name = "flaky_test",
    srcs = "flaky_test.py",
)
$ cat flaky_test.py
import random
import sys

if random.random() > 0.5:
    sys.exit(1)
```
Run the following command until the test fails
```
$ bazel test //:python_test --nocache_test_results --config=remote_exec --flaky_test_attempts=4 --remote_download_minimal
```
The `--config=remote_exec` should configure bazel to execute the actions remotely.

### Which operating system are you running Bazel on?


Ubuntu 20.04

### What is the output of `bazel info release`?


development version

### If `bazel info release` returns `development version` or `(@non-git)`, tell us how you built Bazel.


bazel build //src:bazel-bin

### What's the output of `git remote get-url origin; git rev-parse master; git rev-parse HEAD` ?


```text
de02e3f62598dbe8dcff68b4040f34da3322c720
de02e3f62598dbe8dcff68b4040f34da3322c720
```


### Have you found anything relevant by searching the web?

_No response_

### Any other information, logs, or outputs that you want to share?

The culprit for this bug seems to be https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/pull/16123 Tagging @coeuvre as the PR author if he were to come up with a quick fix.
comments:
Thanks for the report. I am able to reproduce this locally.

The fix is fairly easy though: we just need to override `renameTo` method in `RemoteActionFileSystem`. I will wait until #16283 is submitted because it makes lots of changes to `RemoteActionFileSystem`.

review_comments: Should we assert that `sourcePath` and `targetPath` are under `outputBase`? (I can't imagine a legitimate use case for moving to or from a different root.) And in that case, do we ever need to fall back to the local filesystem?

Added assertions for `sourcePath` and `targetPath`. Considering dynamic execution, both local and remote could have files so we need to try to rename on both. Also if the file is in the remote AND local (because it was staged), we need to keep them in sync.
Same as above - is it stricly necessary to create the directory in the local filesystem?
yes, for dynamic execution AND for action logs.
